# @three-ws/agents

> TypeScript SDK for the three.ws v1 Agents API: create, start and chat with AI agents, run goals, automate, and trade from Solana agent wallets.

@three-ws/agents is a JavaScript library from three.ws. Install: `npm install @three-ws/agents`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-agents/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-agents/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-agents/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-agents/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
